All wired to the S1/S1.5 * backend endpoints — no new page tree, no new mobile. * * Route: `/soshie` (Admin only). */ import React, { useState } from "react"; import { Sparkles } from "lucide-react"; import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent } from "@/components/ui/tabs"; import { PageHeader } from "@/components/ui-kit"; import BrandBrainTab from "./BrandBrainTab"; import AutopilotSchedulesTab from "./AutopilotSchedulesTab"; import ReviewQueueTab from "./ReviewQueueTab"; export default function SoshieHub() { const [tab, setTab] = useState("brand-brain"); return (
